notes: The ASV recasts וַיְחַבְּרֵהוּ עִמּוֹ as joined himself with him, reversing the two participants' roles. The alignment is structural: the verb's object suffix takes the verb's English object himself and the preposition's suffix takes the preposition's object him. The unit note's phrase where its own referent stands is loose — the correspondence is object to object and prepositional object to prepositional object, not referential, since the ASV has swapped which participant each denotes. The competing referential mapping (object suffix to him, prepositional suffix to himself) crosses the two phrases and was not taken.
